title: Uruguayan Sprouts and Wrap Keto Meal
description: A delicious and healthy keto meal using uruguayan wrap, nutty flavors, and brussels sprouts.
instructions: Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and toss to coat.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, slice the uruguayan wrap into strips.
In a pan, heat some oil over medium heat and add the sliced wrap.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with nutty seasoning.
Serve the roasted Brussels sprouts with the crispy wrap strips.
Optional: sprinkle with paprika for extra flavor.
